construction_target.sum_note: manufacturer compressionThickness .7992mm; order nominal .8 +/- .1mm, do not rescale dielectric to force sum .8

local_copper.reason: localized return/thermal spreading below U2/C1, tied to the buck ground by two stitch vias beside C1.2/U2.4; DS41326 Rev3-2 page15 recommends bottom GND copper; on the power return branch only, never touching the quiet branch or the J5.2 pad; no whole-board plane; thermal performance still needs bench

construction_target.wide_trace_reason: 0.6mm B.Cu quiet-ground trunk from the J5.2 pin to the single MCU ground via under U1 lowers the shared CV/ADC reference impedance; every other trace is <=0.3mm. Real trace only, not broad fill.

optical_manufacturing.surface_finish_status: project choice for exposed copper and fine-pitch assembly; final factory DFM/order configuration remains unconfirmed

mask_policy.semantics: F.Mask and B.Mask graphics are openings, not retained mask
mask_policy.reason: retain only pad solder dams/wicking barriers, narrow solder isolation over surface copper (native solder_mask_bridge prevention), via tents and polarity/assembly silk backing; exact rectangles recorded per board
mask_policy.paste: normal footprint apertures only; no new paste graphics
mask_policy.verification: compare exported positive mask Gerbers to these protected rectangles and pad apertures; fail if any opening, including a pad aperture, comes within via_web_mm of via copper
mask_policy.ink_thickness_status: JLC published minimum, used only as preview/stackup convention; local coating not measured
mask_policy.via_web_reason: Every via keeps at least this much mask between its copper and ANY effective opening, generated rectangle or component pad aperture alike (JLC green 1 oz mask bridge 0.10 mm, same source row). The router keeps via copper this far from every pad aperture (no via in or against a pad); a7_optical_check.py proves it on the native residual mask and a7_gerber_inspect.py on the plotted Gerbers.

The PCBA minimum is "2 pcs" in the capability table. With Panel by JLCPCB the PCB quantity counts panels (JLC: 10 pcs ordered gives 10 panels); whether the PCBA quantity also counts panels, and whether one panel holding 2 or more boards meets the 2-pcs minimum, is not sourced. Question for the JLC order form or support: "With Panel by JLCPCB, does the PCBA Qty count panels or single boards, and does one panel holding 2 or more boards meet the 2-pcs PCBA minimum, or must 2 panels be assembled?" The owner stated, without asking JLC, that each Gerber is ordered at PCBA quantity 2 or more (jlc-questions); this is owner-stated, not JLC-confirmed.
